name: Mine Stability Check
description: Inspect the mine supports and calculate whether the beam is close to its load limit.

steps.description: Inspect the timber support beam for cracks, shifting, and load paths.
Calculate that 450 kg on a 500 kg beam uses 90% of capacity.
Record how lantern light, support spacing, and rubble density reveal mine safety conditions.

reward.label: Mine stability check
reward.childMessage: You checked the mine before trusting it.
